description: Returns revision metadata (revision ID, timestamp, user, comment, size, minor flag) for a wiki page, in segments of 20 revisions, newest first. Paginate with olderThan or newerThan (mutually exclusive). If the title does not exist, an error is returned. Boolean flags appear only when true.

filter.description: Change tag — return only revisions carrying this tag

newerThan.description: Revision ID — return revisions newer than this (exclusive). Mutually exclusive with olderThan.

olderThan.description: Revision ID — return revisions older than this (exclusive). Mutually exclusive with newerThan.

wiki.description: Wiki to target, as a key from the mcp://wikis/ resources (e.g. en.wikipedia.org), or the full mcp://wikis/ URI. Omit to use the default wiki.

name: get-page-history
